1. Problem Setting / 问题背景

English. Let be an undirected, unweighted multigraph. A multigraph may contain parallel edges between the same pair of vertices, but self-loops are removed. Write and .

English. A deterministic solution can use repeated maximum-flow computations. Karger’s algorithm takes another approach: it uses random edge contractions and accepts a small failure probability in exchange for a very simple algorithm.

中文。 确定性方法可以通过多次最大流计算求全局最小割。Karger 算法采用另一条路线：利用随机边收缩，并接受一个较小的失败概率，从而得到非常简洁的算法。

2. Edge Contraction / 边收缩

English. For an edge , contracting means merging and into one supervertex. Edges incident to either endpoint are redirected to the new supervertex. Parallel edges are kept, while self-loops created by the merge are deleted. The resulting graph is denoted by .

中文。 对边 进行收缩，就是把 和 合并成一个超级顶点。原来与两个端点相连的边都改为连接这个新顶点。平行边必须保留，合并后产生的自环则删除。收缩后的图记为 。

English. Parallel edges represent different original edges and must all be counted in a cut. A self-loop never crosses a future cut because both endpoints are already inside the same supervertex.

中文。 平行边代表原图中不同的边，计算割大小时都要计数。自环的两个端点已经在同一个超级顶点中，所以它不可能跨越之后的任何割。

3. Karger’s Random Contraction Algorithm / Karger 随机收缩算法

English. Repeatedly choose an edge uniformly at random and contract it. When only two supervertices remain, all parallel edges between them form a cut of the original graph.

中文。 反复均匀随机选择一条边并收缩。当只剩两个超级顶点时，它们之间的所有平行边构成原图的一个割。

English. The algorithm always returns a valid cut, but not necessarily a minimum cut. For a fixed minimum cut , it succeeds exactly when no edge of is ever contracted.

中文。 算法一定返回一个合法的割，但不一定是最小割。对于一个固定最小割 ，当且仅当算法从未收缩 中的边时，该割才能被最终输出。

11. FastCut: Divide and Conquer / FastCut：分治加速

English. The most dangerous part of ordinary Karger contraction occurs near the end, when few vertices remain and the probability of hitting the minimum cut becomes large. FastCut stops earlier, creates two independent contracted graphs, and recursively solves both.

中文。 普通 Karger 收缩最危险的是后期：剩余顶点很少时，碰到最小割边的概率变大。FastCut 提前停止，独立生成两个收缩图，再分别递归求解。

中文。 当 时，一个固定最小割在单个分支中存活的概率至少为

English. Since the two branches are generated independently, the probability that at least one branch preserves the cut is at least , before accounting for later recursive calls.

English. A full recursive analysis gives one-run success probability . Repeating FastCut independently times raises the success probability to high probability.

中文。 完整的递归分析可得，FastCut 单次成功概率为 。再独立重复 次，就可以把成功率提高到高概率。

14. Common Points of Confusion / 常见易错点

English. “Uniformly choose an edge” means uniform over edge copies, not uniform over adjacent vertex pairs. Three parallel edges must make that pair three times as likely to be selected as a pair joined by one edge.

中文。 “均匀随机选择一条边”是对边副本均匀，而不是对相邻顶点对均匀。三条平行边会使该顶点对被选中的概率变成只有一条边时的三倍。

English. Contracting an edge of one fixed minimum cut destroys that cut, but does not necessarily make the whole run fail; another minimum cut may survive.

中文。 收缩某个固定最小割中的边会破坏该割，但不一定意味着整次运行失败；另一个最小割仍可能存活。

English. The product of survival probabilities uses conditional probabilities. Independence between contraction steps is not assumed.

中文。 存活概率的乘积使用条件概率，并没有假设各轮收缩事件相互独立。

English. The bounds and are guaranteed lower bounds, not exact probabilities for every graph.

中文。 和 都是保证成立的下界，不是每张图上的精确概率。

English. In , the factor 2 controls the width of the recursion tree. Repeated shrinking by controls its depth.

中文。 在 中，系数 2 决定递归树的宽度；每层乘以 的规模缩减决定其 深度。

16. One-Sentence Summary / 一句话总结

English. Karger’s algorithm repeatedly merges randomly chosen adjacent groups; a fixed minimum cut is found whenever none of its edges is contracted, and independent repetition or divide-and-conquer turns this simple idea into an effective randomized min-cut algorithm.

中文。 Karger 算法不断随机合并相邻顶点组；只要某个固定最小割中的边从未被收缩，该割就会被找到，而独立重复或分治递归可以把这一简单思想变成有效的随机最小割算法。
